outcome: Latency period from rupture of membranes to delivery
cohort: Pregnant women at Tikur Anbessa Hospital, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, from June 2010 to June 2013
finding: Although the prevalence of PPROM in this study appears lower than many prior reports, the level of maternal and perinatal morbidity is high compared to many prior reports from similar setups, particularly the proportion of mothers presenting with established chorioamnionitis.
